report.name: Loader, repaired document and required authentication
Corrupt local storage cannot interrupt startup
Mobile menu, focus return and keyboard carousel
Quick controls: cart saves/removes without modifying Rings or unrelated data
Rings display reads a subscribed fixture and never writes a balance
Theme persists and restores after reload
Fanart filters, search, empty state and modal close button
Large fanart fixture paginates and filters reset the visible limit
All existing routes, loader recovery and responsive layouts
Decoded local images, screenshot and reduced-motion carousel

limitations: External services blocked. Firebase login, live writes, uploads and real administrative permissions not exercised.
Rings use a read-only fixture. Home screenshots dismiss only the local presentation gate.
Chromium responsive emulation; not physical Android/iOS or cross-browser certification.
